title: Managed Identities
description: Discover how Azure managed identities eliminate the need to store credentials in your application code.

data.text: Developers often store database passwords, API keys, or certificate thumbprints in appsettings.json or environment variables. If someone steals that file, they have your credentials. Managed identities solve this by giving your Azure resource an identity Azure manages for you.
A managed identity is an automatically managed identity in Entra ID. You never create or rotate its credentials — Azure does it for you.

data.title: Types of Managed Identities
items: System-assigned — tied to a single Azure resource; deleted when the resource is deleted
User-assigned — standalone resource you can assign to multiple resources

data.caption: How a managed identity replaces secrets in application code.
data.definition:
flowchart LR
    A["App Service / VM / Function"] -->|"Request access token"| M["Managed Identity"]
    M -->|"No password needed"| E["Entra ID"]
    E -->|"Returns access token"| M
    M -->|"Returns token"| A
    A -->|"Call with token"| S["Azure Key Vault / SQL / Storage"]

data.title: Enable System-Assigned Managed Identity on an App Service
data.content: Turn on managed identity so your web app can authenticate to other Azure services.
data.code:
# Enable system-assigned managed identity
az webapp identity assign   --name myWebApp   --resource-group myResourceGroup

# Output shows the principalId you will use in role assignments

data.title: Get an Access Token from Code (C#)
data.content: Use the Azure SDK to request an access token for Key Vault without any secret in code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Managed identities remove secrets from code entirely.
System-assigned identities live and die with the Azure resource.
User-assigned identities are reusable across multiple resources.
DefaultAzureCredential automatically picks up the managed identity in Azure.
data.takeaway: Always use managed identities when running inside Azure. They are more secure than any client secret.
